**Creator-reported model · Source-only; not independently reproduced**

One existing two-target experiment, not two new cases. The right edit starts again from the original, not from the left result. The source says both target bodies changed, annotations disappeared and other pixels also drifted; these are publisher observations, not our pixel tests. The actual full edit prompt is publicly displayed and linked. Decorative cover art and evidence-viewer screenshots are excluded. No media requests were made.
